# Enabling columnMenu at runtime throws VDom createDeltas root-mismatch error

## Context

In `neomjs/neo#19964`'s CI run (`component-tests (2/3)`, job `119283799142`), `test/playwright/component/grid/HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs:133` (`"menus turned on at runtime keep content-sized cells under their headers"`) failed on attempt 1 with:

```text
Error: createDeltas() must be called for the same node
```

when `await neo.setConfig('grid-column-menu-runtime', {columnMenu: true})` executed. Reproduced locally on `dev` (`1f00cd921f`): `npx playwright test --config buildScripts/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs test/playwright/component/grid/HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs -g "menus turned on at runtime" --repeat-each=5` fails 5/5 with `Error: createDeltas() must be called for the same node` in the VDom worker.

## The Problem

Commit `ad418ae805` (`#19960` / `#19954`, `feat(grid): show hint on right-click of menu-disabled headers`) added `this.up('grid-header-wrapper')?.syncColumnMenuState()` to `Neo.grid.header.Button#afterSetColumnMenu(value, oldValue)` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:318-332`) alongside `this.headerWrapper.syncColumnMenuState()` at the end of `Neo.grid.Container#afterSetColumnMenu(value, oldValue)` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:454-464`).

When `columnMenu` is enabled at runtime on a mounted grid (`grid.columnMenu = true`) or on an already-constructed header button (`button.columnMenu = true`), two ordering hazards collide with `Button`'s root-wrapping transition (`#19757`):

1. **Mid-loop `syncColumnMenuState()` during `Container#afterSetColumnMenu` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:456-462`):**
   - `Container#afterSetColumnMenu` iterates over `this.columns.items`, setting `button.columnMenu = true` on each inherited column button (`button9`, `button10`, `button11`).
   - On `i = 0` (`button9.columnMenu = true`), `Button#afterSetColumnMenu` immediately invokes `headerWrapper.syncColumnMenuState()` while `button10.columnMenu` and `button11.columnMenu` are still `false`.
   - `syncColumnMenuState()` sees `active === true` (from `button9`) and `!item.columnMenu === true` on `button10` and `button11`, so it calls `item.toggleCls('neo-grid-menu-hint', true)` on `button10` and `button11` while their `menuRootWrapped` is still `false`.
   - Because `menuRootWrapped` is `false`, `Button#updateVdom`'s parent-delegation guard (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:407`) does not fire; `button10` and `button11` each start an independent child-scoped `executeVdomUpdate()` (which yields for `1ms` at `setTimeout(resolve, 1)` in `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:274`).
   - Immediately afterward in the same synchronous loop (`i = 1`, `i = 2`), `button10.columnMenu = true` and `button11.columnMenu = true` queue `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')`, whose `.then(...)` microtasks run before the `1ms` timer and call `owner.prepareColumnMenuWrapper()` → `owner.wrapColumnMenuRoot()`. That mutates `button10._vdom.id` and `button11._vdom.id` to `'...__wrapper'` while their child-scoped `executeVdomUpdate()` calls are already in flight (`isUpdating === true`), and `toolbar.update()` yields to the in-flight children (`isChildUpdating()`). When the `1ms` timer fires, `VdomHelper.update` compares `vdom.id = 'neo-grid-header-button-10__wrapper'` against `vnode.id = 'neo-grid-header-button-10'` and throws `Error: createDeltas() must be called for the same node`.
2. **Premature `syncColumnMenuState()` before `prepareColumnMenuWrapper()` on a single button (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:318-332`):**
   - Even when a single menu-disabled button in a grid that already has menus (so the button currently carries `neo-grid-menu-hint`) has `button.columnMenu = true` set at runtime, `Button#afterSetColumnMenu` calls `syncColumnMenuState()` synchronously *before* `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')` resolves and calls `prepareColumnMenuWrapper()`.
   - `syncColumnMenuState()` calls `button.toggleCls('neo-grid-menu-hint', false)` while `button.menuRootWrapped` is still `false`, starting a child-scoped `executeVdomUpdate()` that races the microtask-resolved `prepareColumnMenuWrapper()` root swap in the exact same way.

**Design authority:** `#19757` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:335-359`, `:401-413`, *"Lets the parent own a root-shape transition; a child diff requires unchanged root identity"*) and `#19954` (`src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs:289-311`, `syncColumnMenuState()`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.grid.header.Button#onConstructed` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:340-343`) already wraps the button's root synchronously (`this.columnMenu && this.wrapColumnMenuRoot()`) when `columnMenu: true` is present at construction time, precisely so the lazy `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')` only installs the trigger later without swapping the root mid-render.
- When `columnMenu: true` is set *after* construction (`this.isConstructed === true`), waiting until `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')` resolves to call `this.prepareColumnMenuWrapper()` leaves a window where synchronous class mutations (`syncColumnMenuState()`'s `toggleCls('neo-grid-menu-hint', false)`) run on the unwrapped root (`menuRootWrapped === false`), bypassing `Button#updateVdom`'s parent-delegation guard (`if (this.menuRootWrapped && this.vnode && this.vnode.id !== this.vdom.id && this.parent?.vnode)`).
- Furthermore, `Neo.grid.Container#afterSetColumnMenu` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:454-464`) updates multiple column buttons in a batch and already calls `this.headerWrapper.syncColumnMenuState()` at the end of the loop (line 462); firing `syncColumnMenuState()` on every intermediate button iteration observes half-updated sibling `columnMenu` states and transiently toggles `neo-grid-menu-hint` onto siblings that are about to become `columnMenu = true` in the same loop.

## The Fix

1. **`src/grid/header/Button.mjs#afterSetColumnMenu(value, oldValue)`:**
   - When `value` is `true` and `this.isConstructed` is `true`, call `this.prepareColumnMenuWrapper()` synchronously *before* `this.up('grid-header-wrapper')?.syncColumnMenuState()` and before the async `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')`. That ensures `this.menuRootWrapped` is `true` and the root swap is already delegated to the parent toolbar before any `toggleCls('neo-grid-menu-hint', ...)` update is queued.
2. **`src/grid/Container.mjs#afterSetColumnMenu(value, oldValue)` & `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs#syncColumnMenuState()`:**
   - Guard `Wrapper#syncColumnMenuState()` while `Container#afterSetColumnMenu` is iterating over `this.columns.items` (e.g., via a `syncingColumnMenuState` guard on `headerWrapper` or `try / finally` around the column loop) so `syncColumnMenuState()` runs once after all inherited column buttons have updated their `columnMenu` state, never on transient mid-loop state.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Setting `grid.columnMenu = true` at runtime on a mounted grid (`test/playwright/component/grid/HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs:133`, `"menus turned on at runtime keep content-sized cells under their headers"`) completes with zero VDom worker errors and passes 5/5 under `--repeat-each=5`.
- [ ] AC-2: Setting `button.columnMenu = true` at runtime on a menu-disabled header button that currently carries `neo-grid-menu-hint` wraps its root before `syncColumnMenuState()` strips `neo-grid-menu-hint`, delegating the update to the parent toolbar without triggering a child-scoped root-mismatch diff.
- [ ] AC-3: A unit test in `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderMenu.spec.mjs` verifies both runtime transitions (grid-wide `grid.columnMenu = true` and single-button `button.columnMenu = true` from `neo-grid-menu-hint`) with no transient `neo-grid-menu-hint` churn on siblings and clean VDom updates.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Menu.mjs` plugin lazy-loading or hint-surface rendering (`#19954` / `#19960`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Awaiting plugin import before `syncColumnMenuState()`:** Delaying `syncColumnMenuState()` until `import('./plugin/Menu.mjs')` resolves would make `hasColumnMenus()` / `neo-grid-menu-hint` state asynchronous and still would not prevent mid-loop sibling churn during `Container#afterSetColumnMenu`. Preparing the wrapper synchronously on `this.isConstructed` (matching `onConstructed()`) and coalescing `syncColumnMenuState()` across the `Container#afterSetColumnMenu` loop solves both synchronously.

## Related

- `#19960` / `#19954` (introduced `syncColumnMenuState()` in `Button#afterSetColumnMenu` and `Container#afterSetColumnMenu`)
- `#19757` / `#19758` (`HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs` and `Button#prepareColumnMenuWrapper` / `Button#updateVdom`)
- `#19964` (where the `HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs:133` failure first surfaced in CI)
